scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.mts
scripts.test:deploy: npm run build -w packages/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/cloud-checkpoint.test.mts tests/frame-rate.test.mts tests/memory.test.mts tests/player-experience.test.mts tests/player.test.mts tests/session.test.mts tests/simulation.test.mts tests/socket-transport.test.mts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client
